title: Current UTC Timestamp not able to get it
question:
current_utc_timestamp() function to get the current utc time but its giving error as not defined and

I have imported all functions and tried still its giving issue

can anyone please help me in this to get current UTC Time

thanks
answer:
what do you think about the following example (running in spark-shell)?

scala> spark.range(1).select(current_timestamp().as("ts"), to_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), current_timezone()).as("ts_utc")).show(false)
+--------------------------+--------------------------+
|ts                        |ts_utc                    |
+--------------------------+--------------------------+
|2025-10-02 15:41:42.104336|2025-10-02 14:41:42.104336|
+--------------------------+--------------------------+
scala>

Pyspark should have the same functions.

For older spark versions (<3.5.0) we might use spark.conf.get("spark.sql.session.timeZone") to get the current time zone.
